name: Menu board
description: A café, restaurant or bar menu that lays itself out: items grouped by category, prices aligned, tags like V or New, sold-out items greyed. Type the menu in, or connect a Google Sheet or a Manual table and edit prices without touching the screen.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: subtitle
params.label: Subtitle
params.default: Roasted in-house · Oat milk at no extra cost
params.help: One line under the title. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: footer
params.label: Footer line
params.default: Ask us about allergens · Prices include tax
params.help: Small print along the bottom. Leave empty to hide it.

params.name: items
params.label: Menu items
params.help: One item per line: Item | Price | Description | Category | Tag. Used when no data source is connected.

params.name: menu
params.label: Menu data source (optional)
params.help: A Google Sheet, CSV, REST list or Manual table. When it has an Item column it replaces the items typed above.

params.name: tag_col
params.label: Tag column
params.help: A short label shown as a pill. A tag of "Sold out" greys the item and strikes its price.

params.name: page_seconds
params.label: Seconds per page
params.help: Only used when the menu is too long to fit on one screen at a readable size.
